paragraphs.text: Orla is a faerie of unknown gender from Eldraine .

Orla is a mischievous and playful faerie, known for a lighthearted yet sharp tongue. They enjoy partaking in pranks and revels in the company of their friends, often acting as the voice of reason, albeit in a mocking tone. Despite their playful nature, Orla harbors a certain disdain for cruelty, evident when they confront Rankle about his mean-spirited behavior. Their actions reflect their loyalty to their friends and a desire for a more harmonious environment, even if it means standing up to someone stronger.

During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Orla, alongside her friends, set up an elaborate prank to trick Rankle into believing he was about to be crowned king. They playfully threw rose petals at him and later expressed disgust at his previous mean behavior, like putting bees in their mouth. When Mags released the trap, Orla helped subdue Rankle during the ensuing struggle, even though they felt some remorse when his wing was injured. In the end, they firmly rejected Rankle's plea to stay, reinforcing that they didn't want him around.
